calculation_handling.description: A lawfully existing building with fewer accessible spaces than required keeps its lawful number as the minimum.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the lawful as-built count of accessible spaces; no accessible-parking target.

units.disclosure: The accessible parking minimum for a lawfully existing building with fewer spaces than required depends on its as-built count and is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: A lawfully existing building with more accessible spaces than the permitted maximum keeps its lawful number as the maximum.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the lawful as-built count of accessible spaces; no accessible-parking target.

units.disclosure: The accessible parking maximum for a lawfully existing building with more spaces than permitted depends on its as-built count and is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: The lawful number of accessible spaces of a lawfully existing building may not be reduced.

An addition to a lawfully existing building must provide the additional accessible spaces required by 200.15.10.5, capped at the permitted maximum parking, unless a minor variance authorizes otherwise.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs as-built facts about the existing building.

calculation_handling.description: On a change of use, the lawfully existing number of accessible spaces may not be reduced.
On a change of use, additional accessible spaces required by 200.15.10.5 must be provided or authorized by a minor variance.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs as-built facts about the existing building.

calculation_handling.description: Lawful includes buildings, structures or uses authorized or permitted on or before the cut-off date.
Lawful includes buildings, structures or uses authorized after the cut-off date under Clauses 200.25.15.1 to 200.25.15.4.

200.15.10.11(1).explanation: A lawfully existing building keeps its lawful number of accessible parking spaces: if that is below the required number it becomes the minimum, if above the permitted maximum it becomes the maximum, and it may not be reduced.

200.15.10.11(2).explanation: An addition or extension to such a building must provide any extra accessible spaces required by Clause 200.15.10.5, but not more than the permitted maximum parking for each use, unless a Section 45 minor variance authorizes it.

200.15.10.11(3).explanation: When such a building changes use, its existing accessible spaces may not be reduced, and any additional accessible spaces required by Clause 200.15.10.5 must be provided or authorized by a minor variance.

200.15.10.11(4).explanation: For this Clause, lawful includes buildings, structures or uses authorized or permitted on or before March 31, 2025, and those authorized afterward under Clauses 200.25.15.1 to 200.25.15.4.
